_comment: Production: least logging, and a server that will not dial whatever it is handed.

ApiKey._comment: Keys come from the environment - ApiKey__Keys__0 - never from this file, which is committed. The host refuses to start if Required is true and none are set.

AddressPolicy._comment: A hosted instance is reachable by anyone who finds the URL, and this server connects to the addresses it is given. Without these it is a way to probe the network it sits inside and read the results back out of the error messages.

MediaMtx._comment: WebRtcAdditionalHosts must carry the address a browser can actually reach, or MediaMTX advertises ICE candidates that go nowhere. Set it per deployment - on Fly, to the app's public IPv4.
